newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 22.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Finance Ministry considering 1.5 to 2.5 percentage point cut in corporate tax from current rate of 37.5 percent.
-- E. coli O-157 bacteria found resistant to antibiotics.
-- Lee Hoi-chang nominated presidential candidate by South Korea's ruling party.
